if [ "$#" -lt 3 ]; then printf 'Cannot publish handover\n' >&2; exit 2; fi
mode=$1
destination=$2
shift 2
sources=("$@")
if [ "$mode" = preview ] || [ "$mode" = save ]; then :; else
    printf 'Cannot publish handover\n' >&2; exit 2
fi
if [ -z "$destination" ]; then printf 'Cannot publish handover\n' >&2; exit 2; fi
for file in "${sources[@]}"; do
    if [ -z "$file" ] || [ "$file" = "$destination" ]; then
        printf 'Cannot publish handover\n' >&2; exit 2
    fi
    if [ -f "$file" ]; then :; else printf 'Cannot publish handover\n' >&2; exit 2; fi
done
report() {
    printf 'Handover\nFiles: %s\n' "${#sources[@]}"
    for file in "${sources[@]}"; do
        printf 'Source: %s\n' "$file"
        cat "$file"
    done
}
if [ "$mode" = preview ]; then
    report
else
    printf 'Handover\nFiles: %s\n' "${#sources[@]}" > "$destination"
    for file in "${sources[@]}"; do
        printf 'Source: %s\n' "$file" >> "$destination"
        cat "$file" >> "$destination"
    done
    printf 'Saved: %s\n' "$destination"
fi
